notes.title: Release Date & Progress Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

First, I wanted to thank you all for all of the follows, questions and support. As a lot of you already know, I am a solo developer, so I apologize for the lack of updates and information being shared. Just know that I am working tirelessly on 7Years and am so excited to share my work with all of you. 

As the game stands, it is a vast improvement from the demo, with tons more features, demons, tools and puzzles. With that said here is a brief list of updates to the game:

1. Release date has been updated to Q2 of 2025 and I am currently still on schedule to release the first early-access version by Summer of 2025. 
2. I have successfully added multiplayer functionality to the game, which is currently in testing phase with my testing team. 
3. All 6 demons are completed and ready to hunt 1-4 players at a time.
4. I have added a few exciting new features such as trackable power generator control for the entire neighborhood, camcorders with night vision, demon expulsion items and even EMP blasts for each structure, which are used to temporarily disable demons mid-hunt.
5. I have also completed the "Final Run" which occurs at the end of each round in order to escape the neighborhood. I can't give too many details about it now, but I will let you all know that testing this new addition has been the most fun I've had play testing my game up to this point.

Please follow the 7Years Discord for more updates (https://linktr.ee/wdessy) or let us know if you would like to become an official beta tester. I will give regular updates on Steam as well. If you have any questions, please feel free to ask them in the Discussions forum or on our Discord.

Thank you!
